brief: A caddy to carry my bottle of bleach and a scrub brush around the house.

requirements.evidence: bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-full-cup is a full-depth bin with a raised ring on its floor that holds a round bottle upright in the middle of the cell; staged with a mug prop (prop:1, seen in look) standing in the ring. The configurator checks fit only and knows nothing about bleach compatibility, so it cannot confirm the print material will resist bleach — print in a material you know suits it.
requirements.requirement: Hold a bottle of bleach upright while carrying

requirements.evidence: bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full is a second full-depth bin beside the central cell; staged with a brush prop (prop:2) standing in it, seen in look. Note: it was originally a drained bin, but the brush prop would not rest on the drained floor, so it is now a solid-bottomed bin.

Three full cells in a row; the middle cell (piece:0,0,0) carries a top cover (cover:0,0,0;full;top) with a centred grab handle (handle:0,0,0;top), so the load hangs balanced either side. check_build shows all three cells in one group; lockJoints bolts the walls and capOpenFaces caps the open faces. The configurator checks fit and collisions only, not load rating, so carry strength is not verified.
requirements.requirement: Carry it around the house (portable, with a handle)

finish.summary: A three-cell cleaning caddy: a full-depth bin with a raised ring holding the bleach bottle upright at one end, a matching full-depth bin for the scrub brush at the other, and a covered centre cell carrying a centred grab handle so the load is balanced. Open faces are capped and joints locked; staged with a mug (for the bottle) and a standing brush, both visible from the side and above. check_build passes with meshClash clear. Two honest caveats keep this a compromise: the configurator cannot verify that the printed material resists bleach, nor the handle's load rating — the shape is right, the chemistry and strength are yours to confirm. The brush bin is solid-bottomed rather than drained because the brush prop would not rest on a drained floor.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: A portable caddy for a bleach bottle and scrub brush — I'll build a handled bin sized for both, noting the print material's chemical resistance isn't something I can verify.
